capabilities.title: Connection, library and sync context
capabilities.notes: Distinguish no synced library from an empty one; report the server snapshot time, never a claim of live phone state.

capabilities.title: Meals and dishes
capabilities.notes: Creating preparation is not Food on. Finish does not require results or saving a recipe. Duplicate setup creates fresh identities without replaying actual history.

capabilities.title: Unified log, notes and manual temperatures
capabilities.notes: Manual readings never masquerade as sensor samples; same-ID manual corrections preserve provenance and note links (landed in #122). Automatic samples stay immutable.

capabilities.title: Ingredients, targets and results
capabilities.notes: Typed ingredient/target add-update-remove tools plus save_results / save_lessons are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Preserve missing-versus-zero and food-safety versus tenderness targets.

capabilities.title: Saved recipes and immutable revisions
capabilities.notes: Update creates a new revision with an expected parent; it never rewrites the source meal, old revisions, or an active attempt. Equal-ordinal branches are legal (Room 11); revision UUIDs identify branches.

capabilities.title: Meal composition, presets and collections
capabilities.notes: Typed preset/collection operations are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Never scale temperatures/times; never silently save every dish as a recipe.

capabilities.title: Photos and gallery
capabilities.notes: Reuse the landed private-photo contract (chunked, hashed, bounded decode). A photo shared by several records is physically removed only when no surviving record needs it.

capabilities.title: Preparation, combos and checklists
capabilities.notes: Typed combo/checklist operations are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Checking a task does not record a physical cooking action. Served by the shared companion tools declared under planning.playbooks_guides (kind-scoped: this capability's kinds ride the same tools).

capabilities.title: Playbooks, serve plans, guides and references
capabilities.notes: Typed playbook/plan/serve-goal and guide operations are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Show-guide is presentation, not activation.

capabilities.title: Reminder rules and alert definitions
capabilities.notes: Rule definitions sync; occurrences are device-owned. Activation requests route through device.actions, never through a synced enabled flag.

capabilities.title: Explicit phone actions (reminders, timers, app collection)
capabilities.notes: Sync-excluded by design: activityTimers, reminderOccurrences, probeAssignments, recordings, preferences. Commands use a closed action enum, a target device, expiry and claim/apply receipts; states are saved / queued_for_device / applied / needs_attention / expired / canceled / failed. Devices register and opt into action classes in the first-party apps; the server never claims an action was applied without a device receipt.

capabilities.title: Equipment, fuel and maintenance journal
capabilities.notes: Journal records only. Cooking hours union overlapping intervals. Never manufacturer credentials, configuration, or grill control — see prohibited.hardware_control. Served by the shared companion tools declared under planning.playbooks_guides (kind-scoped: this capability's kinds ride the same tools).

capabilities.title: Charts, telemetry reads and personal insights
capabilities.notes: Raw paged and reduced data are different modes; include algorithm/input version and sample counts. Benchmarks read public-only inputs. M7 ports the merged native calculation engines to a TS adapter pinned to the same fixtures.

capabilities.title: Private drafts, import/export and share cards
capabilities.notes: Exports stay private and authenticated; never call publication or relay-upload APIs. History kinds are the Cook Pack / archive mirrors of the same records.

capabilities.title: Community lookup and private save
capabilities.notes: Public reads use the public-only path and live visibility/block/takedown rules. Private save pins exact source revision + credit and creates no public fork, like, or attempt contribution.

capabilities.title: Public publishing and social writes
capabilities.notes: No MCP tool or credential authority to publish, revise/unpublish, like, fork publicly, contribute attempts, change a public profile, or moderate. Publishing stays a deliberate in-app action. Android/iOS symbols intentionally empty: the prohibition is the binding.

capabilities.title: Grill and device hardware control
capabilities.notes: Never ignite, shut down, set temperature, or change fan/auger/Wi-Fi/firmware/configuration. Editing a recorded target or equipment profile is a journal write (equipment.journal), not a command to a grill.

capabilities.title: Account, billing and credential operations
capabilities.notes: Sign-in, grant management, billing, privacy consent, account deletion and credential pairing stay in trusted first-party UI. Readable connection status lives in connection.context.

deferredDefinitions.reason: Sentinel kind in the projection contract for unsupported authored documents, which stop the projection. It is not a user capability.
